dedupe_keys.name: g3m f global gradient based groundwater model

description: G3M-f is a C++ groundwater model from the G3M developers. It adapts head-gradient flow calculations used by MODFLOW to connected groundwater cells and was designed for coupling with WaterGAP. It can also run as a standalone regional model. The repository documents inputs for recharge, surface elevation, hydrogeology, rivers and initial heads, with JSON configuration and CSV outputs such as water-table depth. A modeller can use these calculations to study groundwater availability and groundwater-surface-water interactions relevant to drinking-water or irrigation supply. Global scope denotes the model design and portability; the chosen grid and inputs determine the actual application extent and resolution. The GitHub source is free under GPL-3. A limitation is that users must compile the code, define the domain and check boundary assumptions; the repository labels an alternative Newton solver as untested. No directly related catalogue record was established. The groundwater equations and example instructions were read, but the model was not compiled or run.
